item.title: Fladder v0.11.1
item.description: Fladder 0.11.1 | Fladder-iOS-0.11.1 ## What's Changed Release is v0.11.1 is a hot-fix release for v0.11.0 mainly fixing local network connections not working on Android. Besides that the changelog remains the same. ## Music playback Music playback has finally arrived after a long time. The music dashboard can be accessed by long pressing the home button and selecting music dashboard. Including the following features - Music dashboard - Gapless playback - Volume normalization - Fade in/out when pausing and switching tracks that are not in the same album - Lyrics - Syncing of playlist albums tracks etc. The music playback is probably best considered to be in beta. While everything works there can and will be small bugs/annoyances. For AndroidTV navigation of the player controls are a bit cumbersome and will be improved along with other dPad improvements ## Picture-in-Picture ## Filters 2.0 + Library search improvements The filters in the library search view have now been improved. Besides a lot of small bugfixes, more settings are now saved. - Allow setting filters for specific folders inside libraries not just libraries themselves - Add any saved filter to the side navigation bar - Setting a "default/favorite" filter that applies instead of the default behavior for that library. ## Ambient blur For the people that don't like black-bars around their videos there is now the option to enable "ambient blur" this generates a YouTube "theather" like blur around videos. ## ### Exciting New Features 🏕 * feat: Add hotkeys to step through frames by @peanut250 in item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v4.9.6
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 4.9.6 | SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **about**: Show compiled short Git commit - **metadata**: Add safe batch editing and matching - **library**: Add bulk duplicate cleanup
### Bug Fixes
- **metadata**: Preserve track tags across collection screens - **replaygain**: Report decoder failures and reject incomplete scans - **memory**: Release retired runtimes and idle download heap - **download**: Resolve missing album folders before publishing - **metadata**: Read quality from Opus in MP4 containers - **download**: Remove legacy HIGH quality conversion - **download**: Preserve native containers before legacy quality conversion - **download**: Publish converted SAF files with the final extension - **download**: Size quality picker to its content - **download**: Allow dragging the quality picker to dismiss - **library**: Retain Opus badges when bitrate is missing - **download**: Estimate sizes from track quality metadata - **download**: Compare size estimates at each quality tier - **replaygain**: Write and verify native Opus gain tags - **metadata**: Match recording IDs across inconsistent catalogs - **metadata**: Normalize artist credits and preserve recording versions - **altstore**: Match source bundle ID to released IPA - **download**: Prepare fallback sessions before availability checks - **metadata**: Preserve Opus tags during batch re-enrichment - Restore SAF metadata fallback and preserve active transfers - **download**: Preserve verification provider during fallback - Resolve backend and test analyzer diagnostics - **download**: Route verification notifications to pending challenges - **extensions**: Preserve verification on availability errors - **extensions**: Bound stream resolution without timing out active transfers - **download**: Preserve audio quality across provider fallback - **lyrics**: Align usability checks with shared fixtures - **library**: Bound playlist picker SQL parameters - **playback**: Retain ReplayGain for SAF descriptor leases - **android**: Scope SAF read failures to each descriptor - **ios**: Isolate download progress subscriptions - **metadata**: Preserve Track fields during enrichment - **conversion**: Reserve FLAC outputs without overwriting files - **search**: Let latest live queries supersede cancelled requests - **auth**: Preserve shared signed-session challenge identity - **ui**: Resolve collapsed header title overlap - **ui**: Improve adaptive phone and tablet layouts - **cover**: Preserve provider high-resolution artwork - **extensions**: Shorten verification timeout - **audio**: Preserve Opus codec in M4A scans - **extensions**: Preserve verification callback retries - **conversion**: Preserve Unicode SAF document names
### Performance
- **ui**: Retain platform link lookup across rebuilds - **ui**: Retain track history lookup snapshots - **metadata**: Read complete SAF tags through descriptors - **mp3**: Share bounded ID3 metadata and cover reads - **library**: Page missing-file cleanup with safe SAF batch checks - **extensions**: Clone only the requested storage value - **artwork**: Batch and throttle cached preview validation - **library**: Reuse collection lookups across selection rebuilds - **search**: Decode large extension results off the UI isolate - **library**: Stream normalized scan timestamp snapshots - **cache**: Enforce cover byte budget during foreground use - **queue**: Apply sparse progress updates with chunked snapshots - **images**: Size decoded covers from layout constraints
### Refactoring
- **i18n**: Share supported language choices - **batch**: Share local track actions and phase settings - **ffmpeg**: Remove unused live DASH subsystem
### Documentation
- **changelog**: Document version 4.9.6
### Styling
- **dart**: Apply pinned formatter to existing files
### Testing
- Decouple app fixtures from extension identities
### Chores
- **release**: Bump app version to 4.9.6 - **ios**: Reuse backend build script without duplicate framework setup - Update AltStore source to v4.9.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
### Build
- **ios**: Require iOS 16 and restore local builds
### Revert
- Remove download size estimates
**Full Changelog**: [v4.9.5...v4.9.6](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.9.5...v4.9.6)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-arm32.apk` (older devices)
#### iOS - **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v4.9.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

item.title: Manic EMU v2.0.0
item.description:
Manic EMU 2.0.0 | ManicEMU.v2.0.0.SideloadJIT
> [!NOTE] > Starting from version 2.0.0, we no longer provide builds of TrollStore JIT. You can package it yourself by following the [guide](https://github.com/Rednick16/TrollStoreJITEnabler).
This is a major release focused on a redesigned interface, expanded platform support, and advanced features. Landscape browsing, library management, and external controller navigation have been rebuilt. It also adds several new systems and brings Netplay to eligible Libretro cores.
### Before You Update
- Dreamcast (Flycast): Existing save states will no longer work as of 2.0.0. Convert important save states to in-game saves before updating, or back up the `Flycast/dc` folder yourself. - Wii: A BootMii-format `keys.bin` is required. - Symbian: Install firmware in Settings first (`.ROM`; S60v2 and later also need `.RPKG`). - GameCube / Wii: The core is still being optimized, so heat and frame drops should still be expected. - MAME: A number of lesser-used arcade systems have been trimmed. Some obscure titles may no longer run.
### Interface
Landscape
- A new landscape library, with most landscape pages redesigned. - Built-in dynamic backgrounds. You can use or upload ShaderToy (GLSL) scripts to customize them. Only single-Image scripts are supported; complex scripts may increase battery use or heat. - Multiple customizable card carousel styles. - Focused background: when a game is selected, its banner can be used as the landscape focus backdrop. - background music feature in landscape mode—besides built-in tracks, you can upload your own music files to use as background music. - built in 12 sets of navigation and focus sound effects.
Game Options and Shortcuts
- A unified options list and interaction model throughout the app. - Available actions are automatically arranged and regrouped for the current context. - Advanced reordering: customize the order and grouping of options. - A redesigned in-game shortcut menu. Shortcuts can appear on supported skins and in the in-game menu.
Navigation and Input
- A global focus and navigation system for iPhone and iPad. You can browse and interact entirely with a controller or keyboard. - Hold Command or the controller’s Select button to view the shortcut cheatsheet. - A unified navigation bar for more consistent browsing and editing. - Many long-press and hidden actions have been replaced with more conventional, iOS-style interactions. - Batch management and actions. - Adaptive rotation throughout the app. - Controllers can be assigned to a player slot. On cores that expect a keyboard, controller inputs can be mapped to keyboard events.
### Features
Library and Artwork
- Covers now support separate icon and banner artwork. Box art is used in regular lists, icons in square layouts, and banners as the landscape focus backdrop. - Online artwork from Libretro Thumbnails and SteamGridDB (Grids / Heroes / Logos / Icons; SteamGridDB requires your own API key). - Switching platform or category rematches cover art.
Game Data
- Game metadata: auto-match, search the database, or edit it yourself (developer, publisher, series, genre, release date, region, overview, and more). - ESRB ratings and matching icons. Rating icons can be hidden in Settings. - A redesigned save-state manager with import and export. - Scoped settings: the same option can be stored at game, platform, or global level, and each can be cleared or reset independently. - batch scraping for covers, icons, and banners. -
Shaders and Skins
- Real-time shader preview, without loading the shader first. - Redesigned default GBA skin. - Flex skins now support customizing button size and position.
Achievements, Cheats, and Netplay
- RetroAchievements pages are easier to read and load faster. - MultiSet support: earn subset achievements without a patched ROM. Switching the achievement list only changes what is shown; it does not affect which sets you can unlock while playing. - Online cheat database: search, multi-select add, and bookmarks. - Netplay for many Libretro cores: host or join a room, public lobby, LAN scan, relay, spectator mode, and room password. Your Adventurer Card nickname is used as the Netplay display name. You can now trade treasured Pokémon with friends over the network, or go head-to-head on arcade systems. - Rewind: add it to the shortcut menu, a controller mapping, or TriggerPro, then touch and hold to use it.
Advanced Features and Import
- Core Settings: intended for advanced users. Incorrect values may prevent games from launching. Settings can be reset per game or per platform. - Settings now include an Adventurer Card, with a customizable nickname and avatar. - Import games from DukeX. - Import games from Armsx2. - PS1 now supports importing `.bin` files directly.
### New Systems and Cores
Symbian (EKA2L1)
- Supports S60v1, N-Gage 1.0, S60v2, S60v3, N-Gage 2.0, S60v5, and Symbian^3. - Touch input, firmware management, and system apps. - Legacy / PPL / TXM JIT.
PC Engine (Beetle PCE)
- Supports TurboGrafx-16, TurboGrafx-CD, and SuperGrafx, with subcategory switching.
Neo Geo Pocket / Color (Beetle NeoPop)
- Supports Neo Geo Pocket and Neo Geo Pocket Color, with subcategory switching.
Commodore 64 (VICE x64sc)
- Full keyboard support, with switching between gamepad and keyboard skins.
Amiga (PUAE)
- Full keyboard support, with switching between gamepad and keyboard skins.
GameCube / Wii (Dolphin)
- Legacy / PPL / TXM JIT. - Wii: Wiimote sideways mode. - Dolphin cheats, including Action Replay Max decryption. - Wiimote skins for Wii
Other Cores
- Mesen-S added for SNES / GB / GBC. - gpSP added for GBA, and can be switched with mGBA and VBA-M.
### JIT Fixes and Improvements
- Fixed JIT failing on TXM devices running iOS 26.6 and later. - Revised TXM device detection. - N64 GLideN64 and ParaLLEl RDP now both support JIT.
### Core Updates
The following cores have been updated to the latest upstream stable releases.
- 3DS (Azahar, Citra) - PS1 (Beetle PSX HW) - DOS (DOSBox Pure) - Dreamcast (Flycast) — see the save-state migration note above - NDS (melonDS) - PSP (PPSSPP) - N64 (Mupen64Plus)
### Fixes
- Numerous bug fixes and performance optimizations

item.title: Aidoku v0.9
item.description:
Aidoku 0.9 | Aidoku
- OCR dictionary support (iOS 18+): import Yomitan-compatible dictionaries in the app and look up words while reading. - Suwayomi built-in source: read and track from a Suwayomi instance, just like Komga and Kavita. - Auto scroll for webtoon reader: enable and press the play button to scroll without touching your device. - Fixed CloudFlare handling: CloudFlare issues that caused external sources to break should be resolved. - Overall performance improvements: the library loads much faster (@Amqx), and the webtoon reader was improved. - Source stability fixes and disable option: the issue where sources were causing the app to crash should not happen again, and now you can even disable a source that is broken until it receives an update. - Many more things: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.

item.title: Jellify v1.2.10
item.description:
Jellify 1.2.10 | Jellify-1.2.10
Welcome to Jellify 1.2.10
Hey music lovers! I've polished up some underlying bits and have made a key fix to boost stability across the board. Get ready for an even smoother listening experience when you’re exploring your Jellyfin collection!
* **Android Crash Fixes:** We detected and patched out a crash that was occurring on Android devices, so you can now enjoy uninterrupted music playback no matter how deep you dive into your library. * **Optimized Performance:** Several dependency updates have been implemented behind the scenes to enhance overall app performance and make navigation feel snappier than ever before. * **App General Polish:** We've made various quality-of-life improvements in various components, ensuring Jellify remains robust and reliable for years of listening fun!

item.title: YTKACE v21.35.3
item.description:
YouTube 21.35.3 | YTKACE 0.9.2 | YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_21.35.3
by @itzzace0
What’s new: • Updated for YouTube 21.35.3 • Added a save button to community post images, saved at full resolution • Added Posts to the tab bar, so it can be shown as a tab or set as the startup tab • Added a choice of where downloads are saved, between the YTKACE library, Photos, or asking each time • Added a custom hold speed with a slider from 0.25x to 5x, and the speed pill now shows the speed you set • Added a toggle to remove the ⋯ button from the action bar • Added a toggle to remove the row of buttons under the progress bar in fullscreen • Added a toggle to limit gestures to landscape only
Fixed: • Fixed the app freezing while saving large videos to Photos • Fixed tapping an image in the comments opening the share sheet • Fixed a crash when rotating the player • Fixed a crash when leaving the app while a message was on screen
YouTube 21.35.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_21.35.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_0.9.2_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
